definitions.gloss: rising water level; swelling of a river
definitions.explanation: An increase in the water level of a river, lake, or other body of water, typically due to heavy rain, snowmelt, or upstream conditions. Often discussed in the context of flood warnings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{増水|ぞうすい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The river rose due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {増水|ぞうすい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づかないで→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please absolutely do not go near the swollen river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{上流|じょうりゅう}→上流：15028_jouryuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{増水|ぞうすい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{下流|かりゅう}→下流：15029_karyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{氾濫|はんらん}→氾濫：09256_hanran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{警告|けいこく}→警告：02696_keikoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, the upstream area has swollen, and a warning was issued that flooding may also occur downstream.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Frequently heard in weather reports and disaster warnings during the rainy season (⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧) and typhoon season. The opposite is ⟦{減水|げんすい}→減水：23823_gensui⟧ (receding water).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{増水|ぞうすい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (a river swells)
- {増水|ぞうすい}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧ (rising water advisory)
- ⟦{急激|きゅうげき}→急激：02633_kyuugeki⟧な{増水|ぞうすい} (sudden rise in water level)
- {増水|ぞうすい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧ (a swollen river)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{氾濫|はんらん}→氾濫：09256_hanran⟧: flooding — when water overflows its banks, a more severe condition than rising water
- ⟦{洪水|こうずい}→洪水：05065_kouzui⟧: flood — a large-scale inundation
